Tumor HI · upLIFT, a Phase 3, single-arm, open label study in up to 16 hospitalized participants for the treatment of tumor HI, is ongoing. · Enrollment is complete and topline results are expected by mid-December 2026. · Earlier this year, the Company announced that 7 of the 8 participants enrolled in the first half of the study met the responder criterion for the study’s primary endpoint. · Each of these participants also achieved complete discontinuation of intravenous glucose with the administration of ersodetug. · Ersodetug has been well-tolerated in the study thus far, with no drug-related safety findings reported. · The eighth participant in the first half of the study discontinued study drug shortly after enrollment in favor of pursuing hospice care at home, where they died one week later due to cancer progression.
Key highlights include: · Potential $5 billion combined market opportunity. · Plan to submit a BLA for ersodetug for one or potentially both indications in 2027.
